title: ngrok error codes
description: Every public ngrok error code. Generated by `nd gen docs` in the ngrok monorepo.

code.description: The code after ERR_NGROK_. A legacy number ("717") or a name ("SHIP_APP_NAME_TOO_LONG").

slug.description: The code in lower case. The error page is errors/err_ngrok_<slug>.

id.description: The full error code, as ngrok shows it to users.

name.description: The internal name of the error definition.

domain.description: The product area that owns the error.

http_status.description: The HTTP status of a response that carries the error.

message_template.description: The error message. Each {name:type} is a value that ngrok fills in at runtime.

message_args.description: The values in message_template, in order of first use.

message_plain.description: The error message as plain text. Each value is shown as <NAME>.

show_support_link.description: False when the page must not tell users to contact support.
